content:
emily: Heads-up — PR merged but I noticed the SDK snippets for streaming + pagination need backports and a few corrections. cc @sanjay @alex. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

sanjay: Which snippets exactly? python/ts/go? I saw CI failure on py snippet tests this morning.

alex: I ran the preview, the Python streaming example still uses the old cursor param name and the TS example has the legacy retry pattern.
maria: We decided last sprint to standardize on `cursor` + `limit` for pagination and to show both sync/async where practical. Go stays idiomatic (channel-based iterator).

emily: OK — plan: I'll take TS, @alex you take Go, @sanjay take Python. Can we follow this tiny checklist before opening fix PRs?
kevin: Checklist suggestion: 1) update code blocks, 2) add migration note, 3) update crosslinks to SDK reference, 4) add a single unit test for snippet, 5) run `docs-ci` preview.
sanjay: Working on a minimal py fix. Current problematic snippet:
```python
# old (failing):
for page in client.paginate_responses(model="x", cursor=resp.next_cursor):
    print(page.text)

# new:
for page in client.paginate(model="x", cursor=resp.cursor, limit=50):
    print(page.text)
```
alex: For Go I'm changing the streaming example to the iterator style we use in other guides. Quick patch: `Stream` -> `StreamMessages` and docs note about retries.
maria: Remember to add a short migration blurb: "If you used resp.next_cursor rename to resp.cursor; pagination helper names changed from `paginate_responses` -> `paginate` across SDKs." Keep it 1-2 sentences.
emily: TS snippet: I'll replace the retry wrapper with the new `withRetries` helper and show streaming via async iterator. Preview link after update: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4321-ts
docs-bot: deploy preview built for branch docs/4321 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4321 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
kevin: Also fix two broken links in the migration guide: one to `/sdk/py/pagination` (404) and one to the retry strategy doc. I left comments in the PR.
sanjay: Pushed py branch `docs/py/paginate-fix-4323`. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4323
alex: Go branch `docs/go/stream-refactor-4324` opened. Added a tiny example test under `examples/go/stream_test.go` to validate compile.
emily: Cool. If CI passes for each PR, can we backport to the v1-compat page as well? We still have customers on v1.
maria: Yes, backport but keep the compatibility table and mention behavioral diff in edgecases (e.g., trailing empty page handling).
sanjay: CI green for my PR. Small tweak: changed `max_items` -> `limit` in the examples to match SDK param naming.
emily: Merged TS PR and updated preview (https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4321-ts).
kevin: After merges, I'll run a quick smoke of the docs search to ensure new terms (`cursor`, `withRetries`) resolve.
docs-bot: All linked previews successful: 4321, 4323, 4324.
emily: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) add an entry to the release notes about the snippet API name changes, (2) open an internal ticket to sweep other snippets for old pagination patterns. I'll create the ticket now.
kevin: Added release-notes draft in the repo, pinged product for sign-off.
emily: Ticket created: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/SDK-789-sweep-snippets-for-pagination
maria: Nice. One last nit: update the example captions to explicitly say which SDK version the snippet targets (e.g., "SDK >= 2.0"). Saves confusion.
emily: Agreed. I'll add that to each file. Thanks :thumbsup:"
